newsitem.title: USA: Celebrity sees improvements for fiscal 97.
newsitem.headline: Celebrity sees improvements for fiscal 97.

text.p: Celebrity Inc said on Wednesday it hopes to report year-over-year improvements for the remaining quarters of fiscal 1997.

The artificial flower supply company on Wednesday reported first quarter earnings of $0.08 per share, which Celebrity said was "a big improvement" over losses in the prior three quarters that led to a substantial 1996 loss.
"We hope to report year-over-year improvements in our bottom line for the remaining quarters of fiscal 1997 - even without a major upturn in the selling environment," the company said.
